It takes twenty minutes to get to the vegetable market by bike. Tom usually has dumplings for breakfast. Tom learned a lot about history. Also, tomatoes grow well in sunny gardens.
Both of them like dumplings and milk. Last Friday, Tom and Anna went to the vegetable market. The weather was cloudy that day. In fact, the waiter brought the menu right away.
Tom hopes to visit London one day. There are always many people at the bakery. Tom wrote about the day in the diary. Also, he studies Spanish in an evening class.
Tom's favorite animal is the cat. Tom plays baseball with Anna every Friday. Anna is interested in swimming.
